source_note: Imported from the owner's phone screenshots (Instagram app, 2026-10-14). Only slides 1 and 2 of 5 were captured; the Instagram UI (the 1/5 pill, like and share buttons) was cropped out where possible and is not part of the post.

fingerprint.structure: 5 slides (2 seen): cover (question hook + 'let's play' arrow + rock vs scissors) → one myth-vs-truth round per slide, the wrong belief on the losing hand and the right one on the winning hand
fingerprint.hook: challenge question to the viewer's know-how ('think you know marketing?') + an invitation to play + a rock paper scissors standoff that promises a game
fingerprint.camera_motion: other:hand-gesture-duel-card. Two photographed hands cut out with hard edges and pasted on a flat textured felt background, one entering from the left edge (sleeve visible), one from the right edge, meeting in the middle at the same height. Designed card, no camera
fingerprint.pacing: slideshow, 2 short text blocks per round slide (about 4 words each), cover 4 words + 2
fingerprint.text_overlay: bold neo-grotesque (Helvetica Neue Bold, tight tracking), ALL CAPS in the source, white, no outline, no box. Cover headline 5% cap height, line 2 in a light weight; round text 2.2% cap height, the losing statement above the left hand, the winning statement below the right hand, right-aligned
fingerprint.arc: game setup → each round flips a common belief: the losing gesture holds the myth, the gesture that beats it holds the truth
fingerprint.units_note: Rounds use real rock paper scissors logic: the right-hand gesture beats the left-hand one (paper covers rock on slide 2)
